title: 2001 Ribbon cutting to begin the next century for the bridge
description: On May 13, 2001, local doctors Ghanem and Stocek, accompanied by their family, reenacted the unofficial opening of the bridge, a historical event prompted by a medical emergency that occurred the day before the official opening to the public in 1901.
